tips.label: because＋子句
tips.text: because 後接主詞＋動詞，說明原因。

tips.label: because of＋名詞
tips.text: because of 後接名詞或名詞片語，不能直接接完整子句。

tips.label: 逗號補充說明
tips.text: 非限定關係子句補充已明確的人或事物；用逗號隔開，不能用 that，也不能省略關係代名詞。

tips.label: 選關係代名詞
tips.text: 人作主詞用 who；人作受詞正式用 whom；物或動物用 which。

notes.title: because 與 because of
notes.description: 兩者都表示「因為」。判斷空格後是否有主詞與動詞：完整子句用 because，名詞片語用 because of。because of 也可接名詞性 V-ing 片語，但本課練習以名詞片語為主。
examples: We stayed home because it rained.（我們因為下雨待在家。）
We stayed home because of the rain.（我們因為下雨待在家。）

notes.title: 原因放在句首或句尾
notes.rule: Because + S + V, S + V.；Because of + N, S + V.
notes.description: 原因放在句首時，通常用逗號與主要子句隔開；放在句尾時通常不加逗號。標準英語中，不要把 because 和 so 同時用來連接同一組原因與結果。
examples: Because it rained, we canceled the activity.（因為下雨，我們取消了活動。）
Because of the rain, we canceled the activity.（因為下雨，我們取消了活動。）

notes.title: 非限定關係子句
notes.description: 用來補充說明已經明確的先行詞。插在句中時前後用逗號隔開，放在句尾時前面加逗號。刪去補充子句後，主要句子仍然完整。關係代名詞不能省略，也不能換成 that。
examples: Amy, who is my friend, helps people in need.（艾咪是我的朋友，她會幫助有需要的人。）
I bought this carrot, which looks odd.（我買了這根胡蘿蔔，它的外觀很奇怪。）

notes.title: 人用 who 或 whom
notes.description: 看關係代名詞在子句裡的角色：執行動作用 who；接受動作，正式用法用 whom。受格在一般英語也常用 who，因此題目不將受格 who 和 whom 同時列為競爭答案。介系詞放在關係代名詞前時，正式用法採 whom。
examples: Ben, who helps us, works here.（班會幫助我們，他在這裡工作。）
Mr. Lin, whom we met yesterday, is a teacher.（林先生是老師，我們昨天見過他。）
Anna, to whom I spoke, was kind.（安娜是我交談的對象，她很親切。）

notes.title: 物或動物用 which
notes.description: which 可以在關係子句中作主詞或受詞。非限定用法即使作受詞也不能省略。不要重複加上代替先行詞的 it 或 they。
examples: This apple, which looks odd, is sweet.（這顆蘋果外觀奇怪，但很甜。）
This photo, which I treasure, is old.（這張我珍惜的照片很舊了。）

notes.title: 限定與非限定的差別
notes.description: 限定用法沒有逗號，用來指出是哪一個人或事物；非限定用法有逗號，只補充已明確的對象。本課關係子句練習以非限定用法為主。單字與片語例句為 AI 補寫，中譯亦為補寫；grocery 在「食品雜貨」的用法常用複數 groceries。
examples: The woman who is listening to music is an actress.（正在聽音樂的那位女子是女演員。）
The woman, who is listening to music, is an actress.（那位女子是女演員，她正在聽音樂。）

quiz.question: We walked to the grocery store ___ our car would not start.
quiz.hint: our car would not start 是完整子句，因此用 because；其餘選項後面接名詞片語。

quiz.question: The picnic moved indoors ___ the strong wind.
quiz.hint: the strong wind 是名詞片語，用 because of，不能直接接表示原因的 because、since 或 as。

quiz.question: My aunt, ___ runs a small bakery, gives away extra bread.
quiz.hint: my aunt 是人，空格作 runs 的主詞；非限定關係子句用 who，不能用 that。

quiz.question: The peaches, ___ Dad bought this morning, are very sweet.
quiz.hint: peaches 是物，空格作 bought 的受詞；非限定子句用 which。

quiz.question: Dr. Wu, to ___ I sent my questions, replied today.
quiz.hint: 介系詞 to 後指人，用受格關係代名詞 whom。

quiz.question: We did not throw away the bread ___ it was still soft.
quiz.hint: it was still soft 有主詞與動詞，須用 because 引導原因子句。

quiz.question: The game started late ___ a problem with the lights.
quiz.hint: a problem with the lights 是名詞片語，前面用 because of。

quiz.question: Rita, ___ supports our food project, brought some rice.
quiz.hint: Rita 指人，空格作關係子句中 supports 的主詞，用 who；非限定用法不能用 that。

quiz.question: My lunch box, ___ is made of glass, is quite heavy.
quiz.hint: lunch box 是物，空格作 is 的主詞；逗號後用 which。

quiz.question: Mr. Brown, from ___ we received advice, is a farmer.
quiz.hint: from 後指 Mr. Brown，要用受格 whom，表示建議來自他。

quiz.question: The soup tastes odd ___ I added too much salt.
quiz.hint: I added too much salt 是完整子句，用 because。

quiz.question: Many plants died ___ the dry weather.
quiz.hint: the dry weather 是名詞片語，因此用 because of。

quiz.question: My cousin, ___ studies food waste, visited our school.
quiz.hint: my cousin 是人，空格作 studies 的主詞，應用 who。

quiz.question: This basket, ___ we use for groceries, belonged to Grandma.
quiz.hint: basket 是物，空格作 use 的受詞，非限定子句用 which。

quiz.question: Jane, with ___ I shared an apple, forgot her lunch.
quiz.hint: 介系詞 with 後指人，用 whom，表示我和 Jane 分享蘋果。

quiz.question: The children wore gloves ___ the morning was cold.
quiz.hint: the morning was cold 是完整子句，前面用 because。

quiz.question: The restaurant was quiet ___ the holiday.
quiz.hint: the holiday 是名詞片語，要用 because of 引出原因。

quiz.question: Our coach, ___ believes in every player, never gives up.
quiz.hint: coach 指人，空格是 believes 的主詞，用 who。

quiz.question: The milk, ___ I put in the fridge, is for breakfast.
quiz.hint: milk 指物，在子句中作 put 的受詞；有逗號的非限定用法選 which。

quiz.question: May, for ___ we packed a meal, is working late.
quiz.hint: for 後指人 May，用 whom，表示我們替她準備餐點。

quiz.question: I turned off the stove ___ the water was boiling over.
quiz.hint: the water was boiling over 有主詞與動詞，用 because。

quiz.question: We could read at night ___ the new lamps.
quiz.hint: the new lamps 是名詞片語，原因介系詞片語用 because of。

quiz.question: The new nurse, ___ will assist the doctor, starts tomorrow.
quiz.hint: nurse 指人，空格作 will assist 的主詞，用 who。

quiz.question: These gloves, ___ keep my hands warm, were a gift.
quiz.hint: gloves 是物，空格作 keep 的主詞，非限定子句用 which。

quiz.question: Uncle Joe, about ___ Mom often talks, lives in Tainan.
quiz.hint: about 後指 Uncle Joe，用受格 whom 表示談論的對象。

quiz.question: We made less soup because ___.
options: B. only two guests were coming
quiz.hint: because 後要接完整子句；only two guests were coming 有主詞與動詞。

quiz.question: The road was wet because of ___.
quiz.hint: because of 後接名詞片語，所以選 the morning rain，其他都是子句。

quiz.question: Oscar, ___ distributes meals every Friday, knows this neighborhood.
quiz.hint: Oscar 是人，空格是 distributes 的主詞，非限定用法選 who。

quiz.question: The old chair, ___ we repaired last week, is safe now.
quiz.hint: chair 是物，空格作 repaired 的受詞，非限定子句用 which。

quiz.question: Molly, ___ the children thanked, organized the activity.
quiz.hint: Molly 是人，空格作 thanked 的受詞，這些選項中用 whom；非限定用法不用 that。

quiz.question: Dad bought this bag because ___.
options: C. it can hold many groceries
quiz.hint: because 後需接子句，it can hold many groceries 有主詞與動詞。

quiz.question: The bus stopped because of ___.
options: D. the driver saw an accident
quiz.hint: because of 後用名詞片語 an accident nearby；其他選項都有主詞與動詞。

quiz.question: My neighbor, ___ grows vegetables, gave us some beans.
quiz.hint: neighbor 指人，空格作 grows 的主詞，用 who。

quiz.question: The cookbook, ___ has simple recipes, is useful.
quiz.hint: cookbook 是物，空格作 has 的主詞，逗號後用 which。

quiz.question: Mr. Lee, to ___ we offered our seats, smiled at us.
quiz.hint: 介系詞 to 後指人，用 whom 表示讓座的對象。

quiz.question: The farmer covered the plants ___ frost could damage them.
quiz.hint: frost could damage them 是完整子句，用 because 引導原因。

quiz.question: We ate lunch outside ___ the lovely sunshine.
quiz.hint: the lovely sunshine 是名詞片語，應用 because of。

quiz.question: Cindy, ___ treasures her old toys, keeps them in a box.
quiz.hint: Cindy 是人，空格是 treasures 的主詞，選 who。

quiz.question: Our oven, ___ we bought in May, saves energy.
quiz.hint: oven 是物，空格作 bought 的受詞；非限定用法選 which。

quiz.question: Ruby, ___ I invited to dinner, is a famous cook.
quiz.hint: Ruby 是人，空格作 invited 的受詞，這些選項中只有 whom 合適。

quiz.question: Leo stayed after class because ___.
quiz.hint: because 後接完整子句，he needed some advice 有主詞與動詞。

quiz.question: Our trip was shorter because of ___.
quiz.hint: because of 後接名詞片語 the heavy traffic，不能直接接完整子句。

quiz.question: My grandfather, ___ educates children about farming, loves his work.
quiz.hint: grandfather 指人，空格作 educates 的主詞，用 who。

quiz.question: The new bridge, ___ opened yesterday, connects two villages.
quiz.hint: bridge 是物，空格作 opened 的主詞；非限定子句用 which。

quiz.question: Helen, with ___ we discussed the issue, suggested a new plan.
quiz.hint: with 後面指人，需用 whom，表示和 Helen 討論。

quiz.question: The boy looked surprised ___ his potato had an odd shape.
quiz.hint: his potato had an odd shape 是完整子句，所以用 because。

quiz.question: The team finished early ___ everyone's help.
quiz.hint: everyone's help 是名詞片語，使用 because of。

quiz.question: My brother, ___ invests in small shops, knows many owners.
quiz.hint: brother 指人，空格作 invests 的主詞，非限定用法選 who。

quiz.question: This notebook, ___ I use to write down ideas, is almost full.
quiz.hint: notebook 是物，空格作 use 的受詞，用 which；非限定用法不能用 that。

quiz.question: Daniel, from ___ I borrowed a basket, grows apples.
quiz.hint: from 後的關係代名詞指人，用受格 whom 表示借籃子的來源。

grammar.sentence: We ordered noodles because the rice was sold out.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我們點了麵，因為飯賣完了。

grammar.sentence: My uncle, who repairs bikes, works near our school.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我叔叔修理腳踏車，他在我們學校附近工作。

grammar.sentence: The flight arrived late because of thick fog.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 那班飛機因為濃霧而晚到。

grammar.sentence: This jacket, which Mom chose, keeps me warm.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 這件外套是媽媽挑的，穿起來很保暖。

grammar.sentence: I carried the box because my sister was tired.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我搬了箱子，因為姊姊累了。

grammar.sentence: Ken, to whom I wrote, sent a quick reply.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我寫信給 Ken，他很快就回覆了。

grammar.sentence: The store closed early because of a power cut.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 商店因為停電而提早關門。

grammar.sentence: Nora, who enjoys gardening, planted some beans.
grammar.sentence_chinese: Nora 喜歡園藝，她種了一些豆子。

grammar.sentence: We saved the paper because we could reuse it.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我們留下紙張，因為可以再次使用。

grammar.sentence: My bicycle, which has a yellow seat, is new.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我的腳踏車是新的，座椅是黃色的。

grammar.sentence: They changed the date because of the storm.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 他們因為暴風雨而更改日期。

grammar.sentence: Alice, with whom I study, explained the problem.
grammar.sentence_chinese: Alice 和我一起讀書，她解釋了這個問題。

grammar.sentence: I opened the window because the kitchen was hot.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我打開窗戶，因為廚房很熱。

grammar.sentence: Mr. Yang, who teaches science, showed us a plant.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 楊老師教自然科學，他給我們看了一株植物。

grammar.sentence: The children cheered because of the exciting news.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 孩子們因為令人興奮的消息而歡呼。

grammar.sentence: The cookies, which we baked together, smell wonderful.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 這些餅乾是我們一起烤的，聞起來很香。

grammar.sentence: She bought more cups because ten guests were coming.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 她多買了杯子，因為有十位客人要來。

grammar.sentence: Ryan, for whom I saved a seat, arrived first.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我替 Ryan 留了座位，他第一個到。

grammar.sentence: We found the house because of its red door.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我們因為那扇紅色大門而找到了那間房子。

grammar.sentence: My mother, who loves reading, joined a book club.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我媽媽喜歡閱讀，她參加了讀書會。

grammar.sentence: Tom drank some water because he felt thirsty.
grammar.sentence_chinese: Tom 喝了些水，因為他覺得口渴。

grammar.sentence: The kettle, which Dad repaired, works well now.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 這個水壺是爸爸修好的，現在運作正常。

grammar.sentence: The concert ended early because of the heavy snow.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 演唱會因為大雪而提早結束。

grammar.sentence: Betty, whom we invited, brought a homemade cake.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我們邀請了 Betty，她帶了一個自製蛋糕。

grammar.sentence: We used smaller plates because we wanted less food.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我們使用較小的盤子，因為我們想少吃一點。

grammar.sentence: My cousin, who lives upstairs, lent me a pan.

grammar.sentence: The baby woke up because of the loud music.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 寶寶因為吵鬧的音樂而醒來。

grammar.sentence: The oranges, which came from our farm, taste sweet.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 這些柳橙來自我們的農場，吃起來很甜。

grammar.sentence: I took the stairs because the elevator was broken.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我走樓梯，因為電梯壞了。

grammar.sentence: David, from whom I learned cooking, owns a cafe.
grammar.sentence_chinese: David 教我烹飪，他擁有一家咖啡館。
